Meta Platforms competition threat TikTok OpenAI ChatGPT ads Instagram 2026

findings.claim: META 10-K FY2025 風險因子自述：部分用戶（尤其年輕用戶）已轉用替代產品並減少使用 Meta 產品，且 Apple、Google 皆把競品整合進 iOS／Android。
findings.excerpt: We believe that some users, particularly younger users, are aware of and actively engaging with other products and services similar to, or as a substitute for, our products and services, and we believe that some users have reduced their use of and engagement with our products and services in favor of these other products and services.

findings.claim: META 10-K FY2025 自述除社群與廣告對手外，另在前沿 AI 模型與消費硬體／AR／VR 與其他公司競爭，且硬體經驗有限，可能讓他人更有效競爭。
findings.excerpt: We also compete with companies in the development and application of AI, particularly with respect to the development of frontier AI models, as well as the development and delivery of consumer hardware and augmented and virtual reality products and services.

competitive_share_entrants.note: eMarketer 預測 2026 Meta 全球數位廣告份額約 26.8% 將超越 Google 26.4%（預測值，非實績；搜尋摘要為轉述，未取得可逐字原文，列為 clue）。TikTok／ChatGPT 廣告為次級報導。

clues.claim: eMarketer 預測 2026 年 Meta 將以約 26.8% 全球數位廣告份額首度超越 Google（26.4%），預測值。
Meta 2026-10 起禁止 ByteDance（TikTok 母公司）在其 App 刊登廣告，與對手關係升溫。
